maria (docs): Need a short deprecation playbook + migration appendix for v1->v2 and the upcoming model swaps. Keep it lean.

kevin (eng-runtime): Agree. Ill supply alias CSV and note fallback behavior. Also warn about embedding dim changes for compact models.

tony (sdk): SDK change: param rename `stream` -> `streaming` and prefer `responses.create` over `generate`. We should include one-line diffs for JS/TS/Python.

jess (techwriter): Ill draft the appendix: checklist, snippet diffs, alias map, QA smoke tests, and support copy. Who picks canonical snippet style?

maria (docs): Use `responses.create` as canonical. Add an "old -> new" compact table per snippet. Keep cURL smoke test for reviewers.

lisa (pm): Proposed notify: 2026-05-10, sunset: 2026-07-09. Ill prepare support KB and canned replies.
